text:
ingrid: kicking off mg_4727 (tenant_metadata enum->text) tonight 22:00 UTC. quiet window 20:00-23:00. note: high-row tenants may see short exclusive lock spikes. pinging @matt @carol for rollback/rollforward coordination.

deploybot: migration scheduled by ingrid at 3432109999. estimated rows: ~2.1M. plan = online apply w/ 10k chunking + kv-backoff. runbook link: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/mg_4727. quick cmds: /deploybot abort mg_4727, /deploybot pin-version v1.4.2

matt: i'm oncall 21:30-23:30. will monitor lock_watch, pg_lock_waits, and p99 latency. raise pager if lock_watch >5 for >45s. :thermometer_face:

carol: rollback path: snapshot at 21:50 UTC exists. manual unpin & revert schema shim in release notes (see rel_1.4.2). If rollback needed, prefer graceful abort then async backfill of flags.

sasha: did quick staging run with sample tenant (1.2M rows). no visible replication lag. SQL used for backfill:
```
-- add enum value safely in staging (PG12+):
ALTER TYPE tenant_metadata ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'legacy_tag' BEFORE 'current';
-- chunked backfill example:
UPDATE tenants SET metadata = jsonb_set(metadata, '{flags}', '"legacy_tag"', true) WHERE tenant_id BETWEEN $start AND $end;
```

ingrid: holdpoints: if we see sustained lock_wait > 0.5s across >20% of shards -> PAUSE. Steps: 1) /deploybot abort mg_4727 2) flip canary routing to resilient variant 3) schedule mg_4727-hotfix (tiny patch to use async backfill)

deploybot: canary routing enabled: 10% traffic to v1.4.2-resilient variant during window. automated fallback configured to route to v1.4.1 if latency regresses >15%

oncall: standing by. i'll watch the alerts channel and will join the zoom if we need immediate rollback. ping @oncall with tenant id sample.

matt: adding a short checklist to the migration ticket and pinning the DB migration row in tracker. also setting temporary rate caps for writes to susceptible tenants.

carol: posting post-deploy notes template and mention of retention period for migration logs. will draft rollback blameless notes if we hit issues.

ingrid: starting preflight checks at 21:40 -> will post results here. thanks everyone.
